item: 0.5.1 item 36: a failure inside one ingest_emails round is pinned as a stated limit
refs: PR pending; follows PR #1509, R266; 0.5.1 item 36
summary: Two tests in tests/test_newsletter_import_partial.py pin the level below #1509's: ingest_emails commits every commit_batch rows, and a batch commit that fails with something that is neither a lock nor an integrity collision is rolled back and RAISED, so the batches before it stay committed, the failed batch and the rest of the round are not stored, and the tally is lost with the exception; a re-run stores only the missing. The contrast test pins that an integrity collision on a batch commit is NOT this case (the batch is redone one message at a time and everything is stored). Test only, no src change; whether the reply should carry a partial tally stays the decision the gate's item 36 names.
